title: Demographic System
description: Audience measurement systems for demographic notation in GRP forecasts and pricing, across video and audio channels. Specifies how demographics are written, not whose panel produced the numbers — provider identity is measurement_source.

enumDescriptions.nielsen: Nielsen notation. Prefix: P(ersons), M(en), W(omen), A(dults), C(hildren), T(eens) + age range. Examples: P18-49, M25-54, W35+
enumDescriptions.nielsen_audio: Nielsen Audio (US radio, formerly Arbitron). Same P/M/W/A prefix + age-range notation as Nielsen TV, measured on the PPM/diary radio panel. Examples: P25-54, A18+, W25-54
enumDescriptions.barb: BARB (UK). NRS social grade + age bands. Examples: ABC1 Adults, 16-34, Adults
enumDescriptions.agf: AGF Videoforschung (Germany). Erwachsene notation + age bands. Examples: E 14-49, E 14+
enumDescriptions.nmo: NMO (Nationaal Media Onderzoek, Netherlands). Age bands, optionally prefixed with a gender letter. Illustrative examples: 25-67, 20-54, M25-54, V25-54 (V = vrouwen, women). Exact notation to be confirmed with NMO members
enumDescriptions.videoamp: VideoAmp (US). Age bands with an optional gender prefix. Illustrative examples: P25-54, F18-49. Exact notation to be confirmed with VideoAmp
